purpose: Bind a quote-free JNU analysis draft to fresh official target-horizon event evidence before the immutable 900-second cloud request is created.
rules: The draft must not contain request_id, request timestamps, risk_state_evidence, quote fields, bias, confidence, or decision_trace.
decision_input.risk_modifiers.event_state must be AUTO_OFFICIAL or absent; the preparer replaces it with the fresh official event-state result.
A real immutable request is not created when official event_state is UNKNOWN.
Known official event-state coverage must have zero required-source failures and complete required-source coverage.
The request is stamped only after event-source retrieval finishes.
risk_state_evidence and every event source must be no older than 900 seconds at request creation.
request_valid_until_taipei is exactly request_created_at_taipei plus 900 seconds.
The request remains quote-free; exact price and timestamp remain owned by the later cloud quote adapter.
The preparer never commits, pushes, registers a forecast, records an outcome, or submits an order.
selftest_override_rule: Synthetic event-state input and synthetic request time are accepted only with --selftest; they are prohibited in real preparation mode.
